note: LB.8 (legacy-only). One repo, eleven manifest-rooted services. Each channel SIDE (queue producer / consumer, ws handler / client, graphql resolver / operation, grpc client) is owned by the project its file sits in and carries the LB.4a ` @<project path>` owner suffix; the channel itself (topic, ws path, graphql field, proto service) stays the pairing key, and the proto GRPC_SERVICE contract stays one shared node (proto/ sits under no project root). Before LB.8: one QUEUE_PRODUCER / one QUEUE_CONSUMER for orders.created, one GRPC_CLIENT, one GRAPHQL_RESOLVER getUser HANDLED_BY both services' methods, one WS_HANDLER for both FastAPI apps, and `glia arch` attributed each collapsed side to one project. After: every producer pairs every consumer (2 x 2 QUEUE_FLOWS), each grpc client calls the shared service, the web op reaches both resolvers (graphql has no host narrowing). CB.21: the web client's `new WebSocket("ws://chat-svc:8080/ws")` records its dial host (ENDPOINT_HIT `host` on the WS_CLIENT), and the ws resolver keeps only the same-path handler of the project that host names (chat-svc -> services/chat); before CB.21 it paired both handlers.
